method: Agent visual audit of all 260 training and 61 validation thumbnails plus 139 traffic crops. Canonical labels/test are NOT edited. Second pass inspected all 84 retained TRAIN traffic frames at full-scene and crop scale; 17 more shifted-box sources excluded. Signal-only TRAIN corrections: 3=off/ambiguous/multiple, 5=red, 6=yellow, 7=green. No new coordinates fabricated. All 66 proposed cone deletions visually audited: retain 13 real/partial/grouped bollard rows, remove only the other 53. Existing partial/grouped box quality is still imperfect.
exclusionReason: Obvious displaced/oversized traffic boxes or false STOP boxes. Only TRAIN excluded; canonical coordinates and splits unchanged.
